title: Synthesis, characterization, DNA interaction, and anticancer studies of novel facial tricarbonylrhenium(I) complexes with uracil-derived ligands
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,34635-34642
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05387K, Paper
Open Access

Shabaaz Abdullah, Candace Davison, Christie Jane Smit, Phiwokuhle Mbatha, Jo-Anne de la Mare, Irvin Noel Booysen
A series of facial tricarbonylrhenium(I) complexes with uracil-derived bidentate chelators was characterized by various physicochemical techniques. The most cytotoxic metal complex exhibits dual DNA intercalation and groove binding capabilities.
